import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { payment } from "../../../backend/schema/payment";

export const paymentCms = customizeTable<typeof payment>("payment", {
    display: {
        title: "uuid"
    },
    listFields: ["paymentId", "paymentDate", "uuid", "amount", "customer", "staff"],
    fieldOrder: ["paymentId", "paymentDate", "uuid", "amount", "customer", "staff", "rental"]
});
